I will keep this beans plot mostly the way I know works here, because cash is not plenty and beans do not forgive me if I spend carelessly. Since this land is my own, I will put some manure on it, use the improved seed I have seen other farmers around me plant well, and I will spray because insects can finish beans quickly. I will not irrigate because this plot is for the rains, and I will not buy chemical fertilizer for it this season.
